name: Ferienwohnung Kapfinger Barbara
beschreibung:
Peacefully located in the charming Haflinger village of Ebbs, the Kapfinger family welcomes guests with dedicated personal care. The cosy apartment provides every modern comfort for couples and families.

The Fohlenhof stud farm, scenic paths into the Kaiser valley, and the Hallo du leisure complex are within easy reach.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Kapfinger Barbara in Ebbs offers warm family hospitality at the foot of the Zahmer Kaiser.
